description: Source file implementing platform hardware abstraction layer functions for device configuration, system info retrieval, and system control, including functions for getting device status, hardware info, memory info, and system version details.

methods.name: platform_hal_GetDeviceConfigStatus
methods.description: Retrieves device configuration status, sets output to 'Complete'.

methods.name: platform_hal_GetTelnetEnable
methods.description: Gets the current Telnet enable status.

methods.name: platform_hal_GetSNMPEnable
methods.description: Attempts to get SNMP enable status, returns error.

methods.name: platform_hal_SetSNMPEnable
methods.description: Attempts to set SNMP enable status, returns error.

methods.name: platform_hal_GetWebUITimeout
methods.description: Attempts to get Web UI timeout, returns error.

methods.name: platform_hal_SetWebUITimeout
methods.description: Attempts to set Web UI timeout, returns error.

methods.name: platform_hal_GetWebAccessLevel
methods.description: Attempts to get Web access level, returns error.

methods.name: platform_hal_SetWebAccessLevel
methods.description: Attempts to set Web access level, returns error.

methods.name: platform_hal_DocsisParamsDBInit
methods.description: Initializes DOCSIS parameters database, returns success.

methods.name: platform_hal_GetBaseMacAddress
methods.description: Reads and retrieves MAC address of eth0.

methods.name: platform_hal_GetFirmwareName
methods.description: Reads and retrieves firmware image name.

methods.name: platform_hal_GetSoftwareVersion
methods.description: Reads and retrieves software image version.

methods.name: platform_hal_GetSerialNumber
methods.description: Generates and retrieves serial number based on MAC address.

methods.description: Stub for getting time offset, returns success.
